In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the best results are achieved when the dictionary is domain-specific and when it is used to identify the target of opinion, but that the target of opinion should be identified using a domain-independent dictionary.

the best approach to sentiment analysis of news articles is to first extract the target of the opinion, and then analyse the sentiment of the text towards the target, using a domain-specific dictionary.
sentiment analysis in news is a complex task, which requires different approaches and techniques for different views on the news.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of a sentiment dictionary is not enough for news opinion mining.
the use of domain-defining vocabulary is crucial in news opinion mining and the use of a dictionary that is not domain-specific is not appropriate.
the use of domain knowledge in sentiment analysis is more appropriate in news articles than it is in other text types.
The main takeaway from our work is that
news opinion mining has its own set of problems, which are not encountered in other text domains.
news opinion mining requires the use of domain-specific resources.
news articles are different from other text types and that the opinion mining task should be approached differently.
